title: Trakt
lede: Trakt keeps a record of what you watch. With it connected, what you play here reaches Trakt, and what you watched in other Trakt apps shows up here as watched and as places to resume. Each profile connects its own account.
rowOff: Keep watched marks and resume points in step with your Trakt account.
failing: Trakt has not answered since {time}: {reason}. Momotus keeps trying, and nothing waiting here is lost.
reconnect: Trakt needs you to sign in again ({reason}). Until then nothing is sent or brought in.
thisDeviceOff: This profile uses Trakt on another device, but this device is not signed in, so what you play here does not reach Trakt.
notConfigured: Trakt is not set up in this build of Momotus, so nothing is sent to Trakt.
open: On your phone or computer, open
scanOrOpen: Scan the code with your phone, or open
expired: The code ran out before it was entered. Get a new code to try again.
denied: The sign-in was turned down on Trakt, so nothing was connected.
pendingNone: Nothing waiting to go to Trakt
pendingOne: 1 change waiting to go to Trakt
pendingMany: {count} changes waiting to go to Trakt
importing: Bringing in your Trakt history: {done} of {total} shows
signOutAsk: Sign out of Trakt on this device? Watched marks and progress stay here. Changes that have not reached Trakt yet are dropped.
signedOut: Signed out of Trakt on this device.
memoryOnly: Kept for this session only: this device could not store the sign-in. Sign in again after the app restarts.
unmappedLede: Trakt and Momotus could not agree on these, so they are not sent or brought in.
playerUnmapped: Trakt: this title could not be matched, so this play is not recorded
playerThisDeviceOff: Trakt: this device is not signed in, so this play is not recorded
